svg.text: What light reads: the compiled ring mold
a 633 nm laser along x through the chamber, strobed at
each tone: the phase each ray picks up (rms over tones)
peak 954.4 mrad; red circles: the mold's sites (y–z projection)
Δφ = k_L (n₀ − 1)/(γ P₀) ∫ p dx: the measurement that calibrates
the twin against the real plates, and a rendering of the field.
